summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing an exclusive AI advertising partnership with McSorely Media and Mediamark to deploy Outmax in Africa. No special-situation corporate event occurred — no merger, tender offer, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative transaction. The filing is a routine disclosure of a commercial partnership, not a special situation. Perion is the filer and issuer. Terms and deal mechanics are not applicable.
